scripts.build: npm run build:ai-core && npm run build:site-assistant && npm run build:client-portal && npm run build:communications && npm run build:platform-notifications && npm run build:project-pulse && npm run build:private-code-index && npm run refresh:ask-knowledge
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.ai.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.site-assistant.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.client-portal.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.communications.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.platform-notifications.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build:ai-core && npm run build:site-assistant && npm run build:client-portal && npm run build:communications && npm run build:platform-notifications && node --test tests/**/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:ai-core: npm run build:ai-core && npm run build:site-assistant && node --test tests/ai-core/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:ai-coverage: npm run build:ai-core && npm run build:site-assistant && node --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include=api/_ai-core/*.js --test-coverage-exclude=api/_ai-core/contracts.js --test-coverage-lines=80 --test-coverage-functions=75 --test-coverage-branches=70 --test tests/ai-core/*.test.mjs
